# netbox_cluster_type (Data Source)

Retrieves a single cluster type from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_cluster_type" "example" {
  name = "VMware"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the cluster type.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_type_id` (Number) The ID of the cluster type associated with the cluster type.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
